content.text:
I declared the stock **PRs Waiting for SAIL** (`prs_waiting_for_sail`), added by you from your message. It is recorded but not yet placed in the model.

**What measures it:** the store already records the count of items in the `delivery_live` workflow's SAIL-check waiting pile, as `workflow_pile_items{workflow="delivery_live",pile="sail_check.waiting"}`. It is updated every few seconds, so it is a live level. Nothing new is recorded or run.

**Two things to decide:**
- **Is the SAIL check the right point?** I picked the SAIL-check pile because it is the point where a PR is actually at SAIL. The `sail.waiting` pile (the step before the check) is the alternative. Tell me if you mean the whole SAIL stage and I'll switch the measurement to that.
- **Are the items pull requests?** The series counts workflow items in that pile. I have assumed they are pull requests; if the pile can hold other items, the count will be too high.

**Still open:** the model has not been discovered yet (it needs `orchestra run`), so the stock is a ghost on the Dynamics page with "no series yet" until a discovery finds it. Once one does, I'll link the stock to the series.
